title: dysoxylum hasseltii
intro: Dysoxylum hasseltii, commonly known as Philippine ironwood, is a species of tree in the family Meliaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and protecting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Dysoxylum hasseltii include its potential to inhibit platelet aggregation, which may help prevent blood clots, and its ability to modulate the immune system, which may aid in fighting against diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dysoxylum hasseltii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
